A [[human]] '''barfly''' was a denizen of a [[bar]] on the [[asteroid]] [[Borgo Prime]].<ref name="SC 103" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref>{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the individual stood up for [[Unidentified punched barfly|another human barfly]] who had been punched by a hostile [[Unidentified Aqualish barfly|Aqualish patron]]. In a futile attempt to avenge them, the barfly ended up in the enemy's arms, seeking to struggle free with the help of the punched individual, who had by the time stood up again. As the three barflies continued their brawl, they were walked past by former [[pirate]] [[captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood]] and the four<ref name="SC 103" /> [[Skeleton Crew]]<ref name="T19XifsgFS0">{{SWYouTube|T19XifsgFS0|Skeleton Crew | Blast from the Past | Streaming Dec 2 on Disney+}}</ref> [[youngling]]s, who had only escaped from [[prison]] and were heading for the [[starship]]<ref name="SC 103" /> ''[[Onyx Cinder]]''.<ref name="SC 105">{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}}</ref>

The barfly was a [[Color|light]]-skinned human who sported a green, ear-covering [[Clothing|headgear]] alongside a pair of [[goggles]].<ref name="SC 103" />

==Behind the scenes==
The barfly first appeared in "[[Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem]]," an episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="SC 103" /> which premiered on [[December 10]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref> Their being a barfly was confirmed by the episode's audio description, narrated by [[Jedediah Barton]].<ref name="SC 103 AD">{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref>
